cases.assertion: An empty active registry returns a successful zero-section board.
All active registry sections are returned once in ordinal order, including empty sections and disambiguated duplicate labels.
Retired and completed tasks are excluded; membership, placement, content, and operation facts come from one accepted generation and evaluation time.
Isolated-task eligibility matches the accepted governing decision and is tested in both directions.
Cards use deterministic accepted title ordering with canonical task identity as the final tie-breaker.
Card operation and phase presentation comes only from the single accepted open operation and the versioned presentation registry.
Lease attention matches only accepted expired, invalid, or contested predicates and excludes healthy, released, and recovered leases.
Verification attention matches the accepted failed, disputed, or awaiting-human-review predicates without reading free text.
Recovery attention corresponds one-to-one with a named current unresolved recovery requirement.
Projection presentation applies one accepted reducer, threshold, readiness source, and precedence across all registered states.
Hold, abandonment, succession, and projection contributions are unique, ordered, response-bounded, and exactly mirrored by notices.
Task and section route identities are bounded, environment/type scoped, non-raw, non-sensitive, normalized, and collision tested.
Continuation retries after a lost response neither skip nor duplicate cards and remain bound to section, ordering, page size, environment, and continuity.
Malformed or mis-scoped cursors return cursor_invalid; expired or incompatible state returns cursor_stale; temporary validator failure returns service_unavailable.
Equal board snapshot identities mean equivalent first-page presentation, and every contract-listed presentation change changes identity.
Bootstrap and continuation use fixed query counts independent of section/card count and enforce statement, response, and configured capacity bounds.
Minimum, typical, and configured-maximum datasets have recorded EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS evidence with no per-task workflow-policy loop.
Board and pagination perform no Asana or other network calls and cannot mutate canonical task, workflow, completion, placement, or projection state.
Closed DTOs, attention/notice registries, generated client, and service schema reject unknown codes and expose no raw UUID, GID, legal action, evidence, or diagnostic field.
